WISE SNACKING
Although some people try not to snack because they believe that eating
between meals is sinful and fattening, the truth is that snacking is impor-
tant. Active people tend to get hungry at least every four hours, so if you
have lunch at noon, your body will want a snack (or a second lunch) by
4:00 p.m., if not sooner. If you will be exercising in the afternoon, you
need added fuel to energize your workout. Snacking is good for you and
your workouts, and you should make it part of your sports diet, preferably
with a second Junch instead of afternoon sweet treats. A planned whole-
some snack is a far better option than a stimulant drink such as Red Bull
or 5-Hour Energy (see chapter 8).
